```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center")

library(htmltools)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)

result <- params$result
de     <- result$differential_expression
fs     <- result$family_selection
smry   <- result$summary

has_contrasts <- !is.null(de$contrasts) && nrow(de$contrasts) > 0
has_omnibus   <- !is.null(de$omnibus)   && nrow(de$omnibus)   > 0

pkg_version <- tryCatch(as.character(utils::packageVersion("PERSEO")),
                        error = function(e) "dev")

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# ---- Shared plot helpers ---------------------------------------------------

.perseo_colours <- c("Not sig" = "#AAAAAA", "LFC only" = "#4E9FD4",
                     "FDR only" = "#F4A460", "Sig & LFC" = "#C0392B")

theme_rmd <- function(base_size = 11) {
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.border     = ggplot2::element_rect(colour = "#CCCCCC", fill = NA,
                                               linewidth = 0.4),
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#F5F5F5", colour = "#CCCCCC"),
      legend.position  = "right",
      plot.title       = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title       = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.caption     = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#888888", size = 8)
    )
}

make_volcano <- function(df_c, fdr = 0.05, lfc = 1) {
  df_c$neg_log10 <- -log10(pmax(df_c$p_adj, 1e-300))
  df_c$sig_cat   <- dplyr::case_when(
    !is.finite(df_c$estimate) | !is.finite(df_c$p_adj)    ~ "Not sig",
    df_c$p_adj < fdr & abs(df_c$estimate) >= lfc           ~ "Sig & LFC",
    df_c$p_adj < fdr                                       ~ "FDR only",
    abs(df_c$estimate) >= lfc                              ~ "LFC only",
    TRUE                                                   ~ "Not sig"
  )
  df_c$sig_cat <- factor(df_c$sig_cat,
                         levels = c("Not sig", "LFC only", "FDR only", "Sig & LFC"))
  df_c$tooltip <- paste0("<b>", df_c$feature, "</b><br/>LFC: ",
                         round(df_c$estimate, 3), "<br/>p-adj: ",
                         signif(df_c$p_adj, 3))
  df_c$data_id <- df_c$feature
  ggplot2::ggplot(df_c, ggplot2::aes(x = estimate, y = neg_log10,
                                     colour = sig_cat,
                                     tooltip = tooltip, data_id = data_id)) +
    ggiraph::geom_point_interactive(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc, lfc), linetype = "dashed",
                        colour = "#555555", linewidth = 0.4) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr), linetype = "dashed",
                        colour = "#555555", linewidth = 0.4) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = .perseo_colours, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Log Fold Change", y = expression(-log[10](p[adj])),
                  caption = paste0("FDR < ", fdr, "  |  |LFC| \u2265 ", lfc)) +
    theme_rmd()
}

make_ma <- function(df_c, fdr = 0.05) {
  df_c$sig     <- !is.na(df_c$p_adj) & df_c$p_adj < fdr
  df_c$a_axis  <- if ("mean_expr" %in% names(df_c)) df_c$mean_expr else
                    rank(-abs(df_c$estimate), ties.method = "first")
  df_c$tooltip <- paste0("<b>", df_c$feature, "</b><br/>LFC: ",
                         round(df_c$estimate, 3), "<br/>p-adj: ",
                         signif(df_c$p_adj, 3))
  df_c$data_id <- df_c$feature
  ggplot2::ggplot(df_c, ggplot2::aes(x = a_axis, y = estimate, colour = sig,
                                     tooltip = tooltip, data_id = data_id)) +
    ggiraph::geom_point_interactive(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#333333", linewidth = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("TRUE" = "#C0392B", "FALSE" = "#AAAAAA"),
      labels = c("TRUE" = paste0("FDR < ", fdr), "FALSE" = "Not sig"),
      name   = NULL) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = expression(log[2](Mean~expression + 1)),
                  y = "Log Fold Change",
                  caption = paste0("FDR < ", fdr)) +
    theme_rmd()
}

as_girafe <- function(gg, w = 7, h = 4.5) {
  ggiraph::girafe(ggobj = gg, width_svg = w, height_svg = h,
    options = list(
      ggiraph::opts_hover(css = "opacity:1;"),
      ggiraph::opts_tooltip(
        css = "background:white;border:1px solid #ccc;padding:6px 8px;
               border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;font-family:sans-serif;"),
      ggiraph::opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)))
}
```

---

# 0 — Analysis Parameters

> **Full record of all parameters used in this analysis**, intended for
> reproducibility and methods reporting. Each parameter is shown alongside a
> brief explanation of its role in the pipeline.

```{r params-table}
s <- smry

badge <- function(val, tl = "Yes", fl = "No",
                  tc = "#27AE60", fc = "#888888") {
  col   <- if (isTRUE(val)) tc else fc
  label <- if (isTRUE(val)) tl else fl
  sprintf('<span class="param-badge" style="background:%s">%s</span>', col, label)
}

prow <- function(name, value, desc) {
  vstr <- if (is.character(value) || is.numeric(value))
    paste0('<code>', paste(as.character(value), collapse = ", "), '</code>')
  else value
  paste0('<tr><td class="param-name">', name, '</td>',
         '<td class="param-value">', vstr, '</td>',
         '<td class="param-desc">',  desc, '</td></tr>')
}

ph <- function(label)
  paste0('<tr class="param-section-header"><td colspan="3">', label, '</td></tr>')

tm_desc <- switch(s$transform_mode %||% "strict",
  "strict" = "Only uses families whose support exactly matches the data range
              (e.g. count families for non-negative integers). Safest choice
              for heterogeneous omics data.",
  "safe"   = "Broader family matching with log/logit rescaling where needed.
              More permissive; suitable when support mismatches are expected.",
  s$transform_mode)

crit_desc <- switch(s$criterion %||% "GAIC",
  "GAIC" = paste0("Generalised AIC with penalty k = ", s$gaic_k,
                  ". Balances fit and complexity; recommended for omics."),
  "BIC"  = "Bayesian Information Criterion — stronger complexity penalty than AIC.",
  "AIC"  = "Akaike Information Criterion — standard penalised likelihood.",
  s$criterion)

padj_desc <- switch(s$p_adjust_method %||% "BH",
  "BH"         = "Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control. Recommended for high-dimensional data.",
  "bonferroni" = "Bonferroni correction. Very conservative for large feature sets.",
  "none"       = "No adjustment applied.",
  s$p_adjust_method)

rows <- paste0(
  ph("Data"),
  prow("Features", format(s$n_features_total, big.mark = ","),
       "Total genomic features in the input counts matrix."),
  prow("Samples", format(s$n_samples, big.mark = ","),
       "Total samples (columns) in the counts matrix."),
  ph("Family Selection"),
  prow("Bootstrap", badge(s$bootstrap),
       "<strong>Yes</strong>: families evaluated on random feature subsets
        (n_genes &times; n_boot pulls). Faster and more robust.
        <strong>No</strong>: all features evaluated (comprehensive but slow)."),
  prow("Features per pull (n_genes)", s$n_features_sampled,
       "Features randomly sampled per bootstrap pull."),
  prow("Bootstrap pulls (n_boot)", s$n_bootstrap_pulls,
       "Independent resamples. More pulls &rarr; more stable frequency estimates."),
  prow("Top N families (top_n)", s$top_n,
       "Top-ranked families passed to the differential expression step."),
  prow("Group by support", badge(s$group_by_support),
       "Restricts candidates to families whose mathematical domain is compatible
        with observed data range per feature."),
  prow("Zero-inflation threshold", s$thr_zero,
       "Min proportion of exact zeros to consider zero-inflated families (ZIP, ZINBI)."),
  prow("One-inflation threshold", s$thr_one,
       "Min proportion of exact ones to consider one-inflated families (BEINF)."),
  prow("Candidate families",
       if (identical(s$families_candidate, "default")) "Default set"
       else paste(s$families_candidate, collapse = ", "),
       "Distributional families evaluated during bootstrap family selection."),
  prow("Selected families", paste(s$families_selected, collapse = ", "),
       "Families used for differential expression model fitting."),
  ph("Model Fitting"),
  prow("Information criterion", s$criterion, crit_desc),
  prow("Transform mode", paste0('<code>', s$transform_mode, '</code>'), tm_desc),
  prow("Min. valid observations (min_n)", s$min_n,
       "Features with fewer valid observations are skipped."),
  ph("Contrasts &amp; Omnibus Test"),
  prow("Contrast matrix supplied", badge(s$has_contrast_matrix),
       "Whether a user-defined numeric contrast matrix was provided."),
  prow("Contrast variable", s$contrast_variable,
       "Variable for which all pairwise contrasts are auto-generated.
        <code>none</code> = manual matrix or no contrasts."),
  prow("Omnibus test", badge(s$omnibus),
       "<strong>Yes</strong>: joint Wald/LRT test run before contrasts;
        only features that pass proceed to pairwise comparisons."),
  prow("Omnibus test type",  as.character(s$omnibus_test),
       "Wald (fast) or Likelihood Ratio Test (more robust for small n)."),
  prow("Omnibus threshold", as.character(s$omnibus_threshold),
       "p-value cut-off for the omnibus gatekeeper filter."),
  ph("Multiple Testing Correction"),
  prow("Method", s$p_adjust_method, padj_desc),
  ph("Parallelisation"),
  prow("Parallel", badge(s$parallel),
       "Feature-level fitting parallelised via the <code>future</code> backend."),
  prow("Workers", as.character(s$workers),
       "Parallel workers used. <code>&mdash;</code> when disabled."),
  ph("Execution"),
  prow("Run timestamp", s$run_timestamp %||% "&mdash;",
       "Date and time the analysis was executed."),
  prow("PERSEO version", pkg_version,
       "Package version used to generate this report.")
)

HTML(paste0(
  '<table class="param-table">',
  '<thead><tr>',
  '<th style="width:22%">Parameter</th>',
  '<th style="width:18%">Value</th>',
  '<th>Description</th>',
  '</tr></thead>',
  '<tbody>', rows, '</tbody>',
  '</table>'
))
```

# 1 — Summary

> **Overview of the PERSEO pipeline results.** KPI cards summarise the key
> counts from the analysis.

```{r kpis}
results_df   <- de$results   %||% data.frame()
contrasts_df <- de$contrasts %||% data.frame()

n_features <- nrow(de$selection %||% data.frame())
n_sig <- if (nrow(results_df) > 0 && "p_adj" %in% names(results_df)) {
  r <- results_df[results_df$term != "(Intercept)", ]
  length(unique(r$feature[!is.na(r$p_adj) & r$p_adj < 0.05]))
} else 0L

n_families  <- length(fs$top_families_overall)
n_contrasts <- if (has_contrasts) length(unique(contrasts_df$contrast)) else 0L

kpi <- function(value, label, sig = FALSE) {
  cls <- if (sig) "kpi-box kpi-sig" else "kpi-box"
  paste0('<div class="', cls, '">',
         '<div class="kpi-value">', value, '</div>',
         '<div class="kpi-label">', label, '</div>',
         '</div>')
}

HTML(paste0(
  '<div class="kpi-row">',
  kpi(format(n_features, big.mark = ","),  "Features tested"),
  kpi(format(n_sig,      big.mark = ","),  "Significant features<br><small>(FDR &lt; 5%)</small>", sig = TRUE),
  kpi(n_families,                          "Families selected"),
  kpi(n_contrasts,                         "Contrasts computed"),
  '</div>'
))
```

---

# 2 — Family Selection

> **Distribution of best-fitting GAMLSS families across all features.** PERSEO
> evaluates multiple candidate families and selects the one with the lowest
> Jacobian-corrected information criterion per feature. Hover over bars for
> exact counts.

```{r family-barplot, fig.height=4}
sel_df <- de$selection
if (!is.null(sel_df) && nrow(sel_df) > 0 && "best_family" %in% names(sel_df)) {
  fam_counts <- sel_df %>%
    count(Family = best_family, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(pct     = n / sum(n) * 100,
           tooltip = paste0("<b>", Family, "</b><br/>n = ", n,
                            " (", round(pct, 1), "%)"),
           data_id = Family)

  gg <- ggplot2::ggplot(fam_counts,
           ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(Family, n), y = n, fill = Family,
                        tooltip = tooltip, data_id = data_id)) +
    ggiraph::geom_col_interactive(width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", begin = 0.2, end = 0.85) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of features") +
    theme_rmd()

  as_girafe(gg, w = 7, h = max(3, 0.4 * nrow(fam_counts) + 1))
}
```

```{r family-table}
if (!is.null(sel_df) && nrow(sel_df) > 0 && "best_family" %in% names(sel_df)) {
  fam_tbl <- sel_df %>%
    count(Family = best_family, name = "Count") %>%
    arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = paste0(round(Count / sum(Count) * 100, 1), "%"))
  datatable(fam_tbl, rownames = FALSE,
            caption = "Selected family frequencies",
            options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "tip"))
}
```

---

# 3 — Differential Expression

> **Coefficient-level results for all features and model terms.** Each row is
> one feature-term combination. The `effect` column contains the estimated
> coefficient on the link scale. Use the column filters to drill down by
> feature, term, or family.

```{r de-table}
if (!is.null(results_df) && nrow(results_df) > 0) {
  display_cols <- intersect(
    c("feature", "term", "effect", "pval", "padj", "p_adj", "best_family", "family"),
    names(results_df))
  dt_df <- results_df[, display_cols, drop = FALSE]
  for (col in intersect(c("effect", "pval", "padj", "p_adj"), names(dt_df)))
    dt_df[[col]] <- signif(dt_df[[col]], 4)

  datatable(dt_df, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
            caption = "Differential expression results (all terms)",
            options  = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE,
                            dom = "lBfrtip", buttons = list("csv", "excel")),
            extensions = "Buttons") %>%
    formatStyle(columns    = intersect(c("padj", "p_adj"), names(dt_df)),
                background = styleInterval(c(0.01, 0.05),
                                           c("#ffe6e6", "#fff3e6", "white")))
}
```

---

```{r contrasts-section, results='asis'}
cat("# 4 — Contrasts {.tabset}\n\n")
if (has_contrasts) {
  cat("> **Pairwise group comparisons computed via linear contrasts.**\n")
  cat("> Each tab shows an interactive Volcano plot (LFC vs &minus;log&#x2081;&#x2080; p-adj)\n")
  cat("> and an MA plot for one contrast. Hover over any point to inspect the\n")
  cat("> feature name, LFC and adjusted p-value. The table lists the top 50 hits.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("> **No contrasts were computed in this analysis.**\n")
  cat("> To enable this section, pass `contrast_variable` or `contrast_matrix`\n")
  cat("> to `run_perseo()`. Example: `run_perseo(..., contrast_variable = \"group\")`.\n\n")
}
```

```{r contrast-tabs, results='asis', eval=has_contrasts}
for (cname in unique(contrasts_df$contrast)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", cname))

  df_c <- contrasts_df[contrasts_df$contrast == cname, ]
  if (!is.null(de$selection) && "best_family" %in% names(de$selection))
    df_c <- merge(df_c, de$selection[, c("feature", "best_family")],
                  by = "feature", all.x = TRUE)

  n_sig_c <- sum(!is.na(df_c$p_adj) & df_c$p_adj < 0.05)
  cat(sprintf("**%d significant features** (FDR &lt; 5%%) out of %d tested.\n\n",
              n_sig_c, nrow(df_c)))

  # Volcano
  tryCatch({
    cat("**Volcano plot** — log fold change vs. &minus;log&#x2081;&#x2080;(p-adj).\n\n")
    print(tagList(as_girafe(make_volcano(df_c))))
    cat("\n\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("> *Volcano plot could not be rendered: %s*\n\n",
                conditionMessage(e)))
  })

  # MA
  tryCatch({
    cat("**MA plot** — mean expression vs. log fold change.\n\n")
    print(tagList(as_girafe(make_ma(df_c))))
    cat("\n\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("> *MA plot could not be rendered: %s*\n\n",
                conditionMessage(e)))
  })

  # Top hits table
  tryCatch({
    cat("**Top hits** (up to 50 features with lowest adjusted p-value).\n\n")
    top_tbl <- df_c %>%
      filter(!is.na(p_adj)) %>%
      arrange(p_adj) %>%
      head(50) %>%
      mutate(
        across(any_of(c("estimate", "se")), ~ round(., 4)),
        across(any_of("z"),       ~ round(., 3)),
        across(any_of("p_value"), ~ signif(., 3)),
        across(any_of("p_adj"),   ~ signif(., 3))
      ) %>%
      select(any_of(c("feature", "estimate", "se", "z", "p_value", "p_adj",
                      "best_family")))
    print(tagList(
      datatable(top_tbl, rownames = FALSE,
                caption = paste0("Top features — ", cname),
                options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "tip", scrollX = TRUE))
    ))
    cat("\n\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("> *Top-hits table could not be rendered: %s*\n\n",
                conditionMessage(e)))
  })
}
```

```{r omnibus-section, results='asis', eval=has_omnibus}
cat("# 5 — Omnibus Test\n\n")
cat("> **Global test of joint factor significance (Wald or LRT).**\n")
cat("> Tests whether any coefficient of the target factor is jointly non-zero.\n")
cat("> Features with `pass = TRUE` proceeded to pairwise contrast computation.\n\n")
```

```{r omnibus-table, eval=has_omnibus}
de$omnibus %>%
  mutate(statistic = round(statistic, 3), p_value = signif(p_value, 3)) %>%
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
            caption = "Omnibus test results",
            options  = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE,
                            dom = "lBfrtip", buttons = list("csv", "excel")),
            extensions = "Buttons") %>%
  formatStyle("pass",
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(c(TRUE, FALSE),
                                           c("#d4edda", "#f8d7da")))
```
